revision_source: cited: docs/robots/rosie_1400/J5-history.md; 2026-09-15 model revision 3 applies the owner decision on model-specific J5 gearing; model revision is independent of the cell pair revision; revision updated for per-joint encoder_battery, owner direction 2026-09-15; docs/MIGRATION.md; 2026-09-20 owner direction: the definition moved into the robot description (robot_description/robots/<id>/rtcore_definition.json) and the URDF pin became the description's own robot.urdf; revision 6 (2026-09-21, P8-42 and P8-44, owner direction 2026-09-21): rt-core bounds this robot by the description's own robot.urdf and no longer by the retired factory pin (steamdeck/real/v4/internal/legacyarchive/rosie_1400_v3_factory.urdf, sha256 86408cd4), whose arm bounds differed (factory J1 +/-6.3, J3 -4.2..1.53, J5 +/-6.3, J6 +/-10 rad; description +/-pi, -1.57..1.53, -3.37..1.3, -2.094..3.14 rad) with no compiled limit moving because the nine-motor bench's machine limits sit inside both; the description's J6 lower bound -2.094 rad is the nine-motor bench's machine limit accepted for now and recorded as P8-43; every revolute joint's URDF velocity rating is drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm 3000 motor rpm through the joint's gear ratio, 314.159265 / ratio rad/s (J1-J3 3.14159265, J4 17.4532925, J5 23.2710567, J6-J9 31.4159265), replacing the unmeasured 180 and 360 deg/s of PR 122; geometry, articulation and joint order unchanged; revision 7 (2026-09-21, owner direction): the positioner axes J7, J8 and J9 carry a 100:1 gear ratio instead of the provisional 10/1 readback, and their URDF velocity ratings follow (314.159265 / 100 = 3.14159265 rad/s under the 3000 rpm drive cap)
